why: cyanheads/arxiv-mcp-server#10: a versioned ID was silently served as the latest version. This fixture is version 1 of a paper now at v4, fetched by its versioned ID; the assertions pin that the parse keeps the version suffix (2404.03664v1) and reads v1's own title, abstract, opening sections, code listing, and 50-entry bibliography. LaTeXML left an inline element unclosed in section 3, which swallows sections 4–8 and turns the floats after it into spans; the outline is rebuilt from the sectioning classes and the span floats read as figures and tables with their captions.
